purpose: INFERENCE cost, not training cost or A6000 training benchmark

parameter_counts.warning: requires_grad=True counts registered parameters, not proof of updates during training. transformer1 is an extra registered model not called in this forward. The active Transformer also registers pretraining-head parameters unused in inference.

measurement.main_timer: perf_counter around forward, CUDA synchronized before/after; no hooks
measurement.input: real first test windows, dataset float32
measurement.excluded: checkpoint loading, CPU data slicing/stacking, input H2D copies, inverse scaling, metrics and export
measurement.included: model forward including any internal support CPU-to-GPU copies retained from author code
measurement.block_timer: separate pass of 20 forwards; pre/post hooks and CUDA events on default stream
measurement.remainder: profile full CUDA-event interval minus Transformer and Graph WaveNet; includes other blocks, reshapes, internal copies and dispatch gaps; not isolated kernel compute
measurement.memory: max_memory_allocated, reset after resident inputs and synchronization each measured iteration; includes model, inputs, live activations and outputs. Not nvidia-smi VRAM; reserved memory reported separately
measurement.attention: B * 170 * 4 * 336^2 elements, FP32 4 bytes; one dense per-head attention matrix in one layer only, not full peak memory or sum over layers
measurement.CPU_measurement: CPU inference timing not performed; process RSS sampled

per_batch_details.note: Separate profiling repeats the same 20 measured input batches; it does not replace the unhooked wall-time measurement.

parameter_diagnostic.scope: One eval-mode diagnostic backward/optimizer step, state restored; not historical training updates.
parameter_diagnostic.forward_scope: Module-call observation plus MultiheadAttention functional out_proj; not proof every observed scalar influences output.

ram_measurement: Process RSS sampled every 10ms during main benchmark incl input preparation; sampled peak may miss brief spikes; not system-wide RAM.
limitations: Single checkpoint/device session; no between-seed or cross-device statistical claim.
Separate hook/event measurements have instrumentation overhead and are not the main unhooked timing.
Laptop power, temperature and other processes can affect timings; hardware clock/power settings were not changed.
One attention-matrix estimate excludes other buffers, scores/softmax copies, parameters and allocator overhead.
